summary: Verified the SAP price-specs data-trust UX fix on /suppliers page for 3 product IDs (SCR410WM, P27175, ZZZ-NOTREAL-999). All expected behaviors confirmed working via Playwright + code review.
critical_code_review_comments: Code in SuppliersPage.js (lines 31, 532-591) correctly implements RELEASE_STATUS_LABELS, warning banner (data-testid=sap-price-specs-no-released-warning), red/green badge styling, sorting by release_status_code==='3' first, and muted text for non-released rows. Clean, well-scoped UI-only change.

Minor nit (non-blocking): sort comparator `(a.release_status_code === '3' ? -1 : 1) - (b.release_status_code === '3' ? -1 : 1)` works correctly but could be simplified to a boolean-based comparator for readability.
test_credentials: None - no auth on this app
seed_data_creation: None - used existing SAP data for SCR410WM, P27175, ZZZ-NOTREAL-999 as instructed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) SCR410WM shows amber warning banner with exact expected text, single 'M/s Prime Pack' row with red 'Not Released' badge and muted grey supplier/price text. (2) P27175 shows NO warning banner, 'HAMIDI EXPORTS' (Released, green badge, solid black text) sorted first, 'M/s Prime Pack' (Not Released, red badge, muted text) sorted second. (3) ZZZ-NOTREAL-999 shows plain empty-state message with no warning banner. (4) Regression: Supplier Master List table, search, and pagination all render fine; App-Managed Assignments table renders 'No suppliers assigned' correctly for all 3 product IDs. Note: SAP price-specs API call takes ~5-8s to resolve (shows 'Reading from SAP...' loading state) - future testing agents should wait for the loading text to disappear rather than using fixed short timeouts.
rca of the issue: N/A - this was a verification pass, no bugs found.
